title: Quantization Enables Private Dense Retrieval against Malicious Service Providers
abstract: arXiv:2609.36376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dense retrieval, the key component of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieves the most relevant documents by comparing dense vector representations of queries and passages from a large corpus. In privacy-sensitive applications, the server observes the query and controls which evidence is returned, creating both confidentiality and integrity risks. We formulate private dense retrieval as providing query privacy and retrieval integrity against a malicious server, and develop a two-round cryptographic protocol that provides both guarantees. Our protocol reduces private and verifiable retrieval to multiplication of a committed matrix by an encrypted vector and uses low-bit quantization to make this computation practical. We evaluate the resulting trade-off between cryptographic cost, retrieval quality, and downstream RAG accuracy across six embedding models, four language models, and corpora of up to 2.68 million passages. translated_title: 量化技术使能对抗恶意服务提供商的隐私保护密集检索
translated_abstract: 密集检索是检索增强生成（RAG）的关键组件，它通过比较查询与来自大型语料库的段落的稠密向量表示来检索最相关的文档。在隐私敏感的应用中，服务器能够观察到查询内容并控制返回哪些证据，这带来了机密性和完整性两方面的风险。我们将私有密集检索形式化为在恶意服务器面前同时提供查询隐私和检索完整性，并开发了一个能够提供这两种保证的两轮密码学协议。我们的协议将私有且可验证的检索简化为承诺矩阵与加密向量之间的乘法运算，并利用低位量化技术使这一计算变得实用。我们在六个嵌入模型、四个语言模型以及规模高达268万段落的语料库上，评估了密码学开销、检索质量与下游RAG准确性之间的权衡。我们的结果表……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个两轮密码学协议，通过将私有且可验证的密集检索转化为承诺矩阵与加密向量的乘法运算，并借助低位量化技术使计算切实可行，从而在恶意服务器面前同时保障查询隐私与检索完整性。
